description: Clean up season , time to prepare for 2027 #selflove #preparation #distraction
transcript: Re-evaluate everything. That is key. The people, places, and things. As we step into the last sprint of the end of this year, it is so important to look at alignment and look at your life for what it is. We often are so distracted. We don't know what's right in front of us. The best thing that you can do is put yourself in a space of re-evaluation. Going down the list completely, stop wasting your time, and the best time to start is right now, so you are not taking things into the new year.
